verdict.rationale: Raygun's AI Resolution feature explicitly delivers AI-generated insights and fix suggestions using error context (stack trace, environment, code) auto-prompted to an LLM (OpenAI/Azure OpenAI/GPT-4), directly matching the story for its Crash Reporting data. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of suggestion quality, and evidence AI insights extend beyond crash reporting to other data like APM/RUM.
